voip_token_constants.note: All seven content members are required and non-null. The server normalises nothing. 'expected' is the Java reference verdict on 'route' for a server whose audience is server_audience: OK or the error_code. Order: signature, then missing member, unknown key, op, aud, vt, env, tp, did. No refusal listed here consumes the nonce.

signer_identity.mnemonic: sample half mammal radar hold fit era dilemma manage movie razor saddle point dial sadness north item naive gate hockey sample script embark purse myth

positive_vectors.name: register_sandbox
positive_vectors.desc: register, a sandbox token of 64 hex characters

positive_vectors.name: register_token_200
positive_vectors.desc: register, a token of 200 hex characters (the upper bound)

positive_vectors.name: register_did_sha256_hex
positive_vectors.desc: register, did = a 64-character hex id (the wallet's Android-id form)

negative_vectors.name: vt_uppercase_hex
negative_vectors.desc: uppercase hex in vt: refused, never lowercased

negative_vectors.name: op_not_the_routes
negative_vectors.desc: a validly signed unregister sent to registervoiptoken

negative_vectors.name: op_not_the_routes_reverse
negative_vectors.desc: a validly signed register sent to unregistervoiptoken

negative_vectors.name: aud_wrong
negative_vectors.desc: aud of another network, validly signed: the nonce is NOT consumed

negative_vectors.name: did_null
negative_vectors.desc: the client signed a canonical form containing "did":null: the signature VERIFIES (the Java mapper keeps nulls), the refusal comes from the field check after it

negative_vectors.name: did_absent
negative_vectors.desc: the client signed a canonical form without the did key: the server re-derives "did":null from the parsed bean, so the signature fails

negative_vectors.name: extra_key_signed
negative_vectors.desc: an eighth key inside the signed canonical form: the server's re-derived form lacks it, so the signature fails

negative_vectors.name: extra_key_unsigned
negative_vectors.desc: an eighth key added to the wire object but not signed: the signature verifies over the seven, and the content check refuses the unknown key

negative_vectors.name: content_changed_after_signing
negative_vectors.desc: the last character of vt changed after signing

negative_vectors.name: voip_content_under_fcm_type
negative_vectors.desc: a valid VoIP content with message_type = FCM_TOKEN_REGISTRATION sent to registervoiptoken: refused (the route accepts its own type only)

negative_vectors.name: fcm_content_under_voip_type
negative_vectors.desc: a valid FCM registration content with message_type = VOIP_TOKEN_REGISTRATION sent to registervoiptoken

cross_type_vectors.name: voip_envelope_on_an_fcm_route
cross_type_vectors.desc: the valid register_sandbox envelope, as is, sent to registerfcmtoken: its type has no FCM content

cross_type_vectors.name: voip_content_relabelled_fcm_on_an_fcm_route
cross_type_vectors.desc: the same content relabelled FCM_TOKEN_REGISTRATION, sent to registerfcmtoken: the FCM case reads fcm_token_registration_signed_content only

serverinfo_vectors.note: A 1.6 server has no 'audience' member: a port must read it as no audience (null), never as an error and never as an empty string.
